verdict.rationale: CockroachDB Cloud ships an official MCP server that explicitly lets users issue natural-language prompts to list tables, execute statements, and insert rows, and a runtime probe confirms the documented MCP endpoint is live and OAuth-gated exactly as described. This is a direct, first-party natural-language interface to database operations rather than just NL-to-SQL translation elsewhere. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of an actual successful NL command being executed end-to-end (beyond auth handshake), and confirmation that this capability extends to self-hosted (non-Cloud) CockroachDB deployments.
